label: What the loop reads and proposes
section: What the loop reads and proposes
subgoals: Read reports across all active scenarios with the physical context of each failing path
Propose only netlist and clock changes

label: What the loop verifies
subgoals: Accept a change only when no check degrades in any scenario
Confirm accepted changes with the signoff timer and a differential report

label: Authority, containment and reuse
subgoals: Require human approval of the final ECO with evidence attached
Run the loop sandboxed with design data kept on site
Promote validated tactics as skills without exporting design data
